title: CLI collapses onto HTTP
rationale: Owner decisions D3/D5: a local user is a remote user pointed at localhost; client config holds base URL + token only, never a DB credential.

name: remote-command-shape
description: New remote CLI commands follow one shape: pure (context, deps, args) function in src/cli/commands/, guardRemoteRun/guardRemotePlanRun preamble from probe.ts (id check + probeOrReport), writeResult for ndjson/json/pretty one-shot output, commandFailure catch-tail mapping to the warren-b61e exit table. Shared pretty renderers live in src/cli/run-renderer.ts (run rows) and plan-run-renderer.ts (event lines) — hand-rolling a second copy fails check:dups. Registrations can be extracted into a register-*.ts module when main.ts nears the 500-line check:size budget.

name: agent-session-bootstrap
description: warren login + warren prime (warren-fc12): login persists base URL+token only to WARREN_CLIENT_CONFIG / ~/.warren/client.json mode 0600 (src/client/config-file.ts); precedence flags>env>file>default merged in src/cli/client.ts resolveClientConfig. prime derives its command reference by walking the live commander program so docs cannot drift; golden-pinned under src/cli/commands/__golden__/. Registration extracted to commands/bootstrap.ts to keep main.ts under the 500-line check:size budget.

name: seeds-merge-dedup-and-prime-goldens
description: Merging two branches that each closed a different seeds issue silently duplicates rows in .seeds/issues.jsonl (git auto-merge keeps both sides' line edits). Repair: keep the closed row over the open duplicate, and merge dependents' blockedBy by dropping every now-closed blocker (sd strips closed blockers). Also: warren prime output is golden-pinned against the live commander program — merging new commands requires WARREN_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 bun test src/cli/commands/prime.golden.test.ts.

Running the warren CLI from inside the warren repo picks up .env via bun's auto-load, so a stale WARREN_API_TOKEN there overrides both ~/.warren/client.json and a stdin-piped token during 'warren login' (precedence flag > env > file/stdin). Live remote token source of truth is the K8s secret warren/warren-secrets key warren-api-token (kebab-case keys); .env.deployed's copy is stale.
resolution: Log in with 'warren login --url <url> --token <token>' (flag beats env), and run 'warren doctor' from a neutral cwd to verify. Tracked as warren-8807.

description: The globally-installed warren CLI (bun-shebang) run from a repo root silently absorbs that repo's .env via Bun's automatic .env loading. A stale WARREN_API_TOKEN there outranks a token piped to 'warren login' on stdin AND the persisted ~/.warren/client.json, so login/doctor/show fail with 'invalid bearer token' immediately after a successful 'warren login --token'. Tracked as warren-2ceb.
resolution: Prefix CLI invocations with 'WARREN_API_TOKEN=' (empty env var falls through resolution) or pass --token explicitly; long-term fix is source-naming in auth-failure hints (warren-2ceb).

description: warren login (CLI 0.15.0) persists a verified token to ~/.warren/client.json, but subsequent commands (show, wait, doctor) resolve only flags > env for the token — the config-file leg works for baseUrl but not the token, so every command 401s until WARREN_API_TOKEN is exported. Also the AGENTS.md 'echo token | warren login' stdin flow is unimplemented (stdin silently ignored) and the resulting error is the server's 'invalid bearer token' rather than a client-side 'no token provided'.
resolution: Workaround: export WARREN_API_TOKEN (and WARREN_BASE_URL) per command; tracked as warren-c550 (config token leg) and warren-2e3d (stdin + error message).

name: client-config-token-footguns
description: Client-config token leg (warren-c550): resolveClientConfig precedence flags > env > ~/.warren/client.json > default was already correct when a live bug claimed otherwise — verify the failure with a stubbed-server repro before rewriting plumbing. Hardened footguns instead: loadWarrenClientConfigFromFile trims token whitespace (a padded hand-edit yields exactly '[unauthorized] invalid bearer token'), and doctor's auth_valid hint must name every credential source incl. warren login. Regression pattern: stub fetch, call resolveClientConfig + WarrenClient, assert the Authorization header carries the file token.
warren run printed run.terminal state=running and exited when the events follow stream closed before reap finished (warren-7bff closes at agent-terminal; reap.* arrives later).
resolution: After stream close, poll waitForRun until succeeded|failed|cancelled (POST_STREAM_TERMINAL_TIMEOUT_MS=5m); on timeout emit run.stream_ended, never a bogus run.terminal. Exit codes stay warren-b61e (timeout → 1).

name: campaign-controller-cli-seam
description: campaign-controller CLI pattern (warren-d050): runCli(argv, {env, write, clock, ids, warrenFetch, githubFetch}) is the testable seam; config resolves only from flags + named CAMPAIGN_*/WARREN_*/GITHUB_* env vars, secrets are env-only and scrubbed from every emitted line via createIo; stable exit codes 0/1/2/3/4/5 in src/cli/exit-codes.ts

title: cli-env-file-shebang
rationale: Warnings were insufficient: Bun folds a cwd .env into process.env before any code runs, making it indistinguishable from a real exported variable, so no runtime check could demote it. Only opting out of dotenv auto-load at the shebang closes the class.
